responsibility: This header is the broad C library bridge for the mc-boot runtime. It defines Modula-2-visible wrappers and supporting structs for common libc and Unix services including memory allocation, process control, environment access, file-descriptor I/O, file operations, string and memory primitives, formatted printing, random numbers, time structures and queries, setjmp/longjmp, atexit, tty helpers, sleep, and execv, making it the main foreign-function surface to libc that many other runtime modules build upon.
